product_desc: thick-cut marbled beef steak pieces on a light wooden tray, deep red meat with fine white marbling
cook: a person in their thirties cooking alone, plain dark shirt with sleeves rolled, calm and unhurried, the mood of a quiet dinner for one
kitchen: a small refined Japanese-style home kitchen, pale wood and dark stone, a cast iron pan on an induction hob, low warm evening light, very few objects on the counter
prep_subject: thick marbled beef steak resting on a wooden board at room temperature, its fine white marbling clearly visible against deep red meat, seasoned simply with coarse salt and cracked pepper. Beside it a sprig of thyme, a knob of butter and a whole garlic clove. A knife rests flat at the far side of the board
prep_defines: the steak thickness and the marbling pattern
cook_subject: the steak searing in the pan, a deep brown crust forming on its underside, butter foaming around it with thyme and garlic, the chef spooning butter over the top. Steam and a little smoke rising
cook_negatives: grey boiled meat, grill marks from a barbecue, breadcrumb coating, sauce flooding the pan, well-done dry meat
hero_subject: the finished steak sliced across the grain on a warm plate, the cut faces showing an even pink centre with a dark seared crust, resting juices pooling slightly, flaked salt on top
hero_setting: a dark ceramic plate on pale wood, a small bowl of rice and pickles slightly out of focus behind, low warm light
story: into the cast iron pan, butter basting
negatives_global: barbecue grill marks, well-done grey meat, breadcrumb coating, western steakhouse plating with chips, ketchup, cheese
